svg.aria-label: Iliopsoas (psoas major and iliacus): origins and insertion — 髂腰肌（腰大肌与髂肌）：起点与止点

text.aria-label: Iliopsoas (psoas major and iliacus): origins and insertion — 髂腰肌（腰大肌与髂肌）：起点与止点
text.tspan: Iliopsoas (psoas major and iliacus): origins and insertion
髂腰肌（腰大肌与髂肌）：起点与止点

text.aria-label: Origin → insertion — 起点 → 止点
Origin: T12–L4 bodies, discs, transverse processes — 起点：T12–L4 椎体、椎间盘、横突
text.tspan: Origin: T12–L4 bodies, discs, transverse processes
起点：T12–L4 椎体、椎间盘、横突

text.aria-label: Insertion: lesser trochanter — 止点：小转子
Origin: iliac fossa and inner iliac crest — 起点：髂窝和髂嵴内唇
text.tspan: Origin: iliac fossa and inner iliac crest

text.aria-label: Insertion: lesser trochanter (shared tendon) — 止点：小转子（共同肌腱）

text.tspan: Schematic; pathway and layers are simplified.
解剖示意；走行与层次经过简化。
